en.headline: Public housing waiting time edges up to 4.8 years in latest quarter
en.dek: The Housing Bureau said the slight rise reflects more long-waiting applicants being housed in popular urban and extended urban units; the target remains 4.5 years by 2026/27.
body: The latest quarterly Composite Waiting Time for subsidised rental housing stood at 4.8 years as at the end of June 2026, up 0.1 years from the previous quarter, the Housing Bureau announced on Thursday.

The figure remains below 5.0 years and is 1.3 years shorter than the 6.1-year peak before the current administration took office. In the second quarter about 4,400 general applicants were housed in traditional public rental flats or Light Public Housing, including newly completed, recovered and simplified units.

The bureau said a higher share of placements in urban and extended urban areas, where waiting times are longer, contributed to the modest increase. It remains on track for the 4.5-year target by 2026/27, supported by higher overall supply including Light Public Housing.

zh.headline: 公屋綜合輪候時間微升至4.8年 房屋局指仍向4.5年目標邁進
zh.dek: 房屋局公布截至6月底綜合輪候時間4.8年，較上季升0.1年，仍低於5年；目標維持2026/27年度回落至4.5年。
body: 房屋局周四公布，截至2026年6月底，公屋綜合輪候時間為4.8年，較上一季輕微上升0.1年，但仍低於5.0年，較本屆政府上任前高位6.1年縮短1.3年。
第二季成功安排約4,400個一般申請者入住傳統出租公屋或簡約公屋，包括新落成、回收及簡約單位。市區及擴展市區單位比例升至74%，該類單位輪候時間一般較新界長，導致平均時間輕微上升。
房屋局表示短期波動屬積極信號，反映正在消化長期積壓個案，長遠趨勢向好，並重申朝2026/27年度4.5年目標邁進，未來五年每年平均供應逾3萬個公營房屋單位，連同簡約公屋總供應為過去24年新高。
